answer.answer: Both the Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY) and the Central Sector Scheme for Rehabilitation of Bonded Labourer are implemented by the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India [E01][E02]. The AABY is a social security scheme providing insurance coverage to rural landless households and unorganized workers [E01], while the Bonded Labourer scheme addresses eradicating bonded labour through rehabilitation assistance [E02]. Both are central sector schemes under the same ministry targeting vulnerable populations for social protection and welfare.
